what: The invariants list is generated by a script that only a blaze can run (`blaze run -p scripts --bin invariants`), so the row for this lane's invariant and the counts in the page's head were typed by hand, as A12 says of four other lanes.
cost: minutes, and a page the gate may call stale
cause: the scripts are built by blaze, and a lane's VM has a cargo-built blaze that was not asked to build the scripts
workaround: edited by hand in the script's format
